changes: Smart routing covers Claude and Antigravity sign-in accounts and mixed requests (a model several providers serve): quota is read per account (Antigravity per model group), and within a priority tier accounts with quota left come first, then unread sign-in accounts, then API keys; a spent account is never chosen while another can answer
Accounts gains Claude quota and Antigravity quota views; Auto Review keeps 0.7.1's default route for Codex fallbacks
CPA loads only Provider Manager: CPA Helper, CPA Auto Review, Cline Pass, CommandCode Go, CommandCode and Grok are its parts
Cline Pass, CommandCode Go, CommandCode and Grok accounts are provider-manager auth files with a kind; their models, logins and management routes are unchanged
